$comment: Container images used by the build, Compose and CI (ADR-0011/0012/0005). Every reference must be pinned BY DIGEST: `node deploy/scripts/pin-images.mjs --resolve [id...]` (needs registry access; an ORCHESTRATOR/IT step, D-049 — agent sandboxes have no network) fills `digest` + `verifiedAt`, `--apply` rewrites every file in `usedIn`, and `--check` (offline) fails while any digest is missing, any file disagrees with this lock, or a scanned file references an image not listed here. A null digest means NOT PINNED; it is never a pass. `blockedReason` (null unless set by --resolve) records a registry the environment's network policy denies: the image is reported BLOCKED, still not pinned, and --check still fails. Never fabricate a digest. `scope`: production = shipped/run in production (mth-app base image, product database); test-ci = test IdP and CI-only images. Tags and support windows are [UNVERIFIED] until --resolve records `verifiedAt`.
